hints.title: Maintain Window of Unique Values
hints.text: Use a sliding window with a set to enforce that all elements in the current subarray are distinct.

hints.title: Shrink on Duplicate Encounter
hints.text: When nums[right] is already in the set, advance left and subtract nums[left] until duplicate is evicted.

hints.title: Update Maximum Window Sum
hints.text: Add nums[right] to current sum, insert into set, and update the global maximum sum.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximumUniqueSubarray(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        seen = set()
        left = 0
        curr_sum = 0
        max_sum = 0
        for right in range(len(nums)):
            x = nums[right]
            while x in seen:
                seen.remove(nums[left])
                curr_sum -= nums[left]
                left += 1
            seen.add(x)
            curr_sum += x
            if curr_sum > max_sum:
                max_sum = curr_sum
        return max_sum
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every subarray for uniqueness takes O(n^2) or O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two-pointer sliding window with hash set visits each element at most twice in O(n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements classic two-pointer sliding window with set membership.
